name: Big Caring Group Bhd
overview: Big Caring Group Bhd 于2026年10月29日启动首次公开募股（IPO），并在同年11月18日完成上市，股票代码5358。公司披露了与Brego Life Sciences Sdn. Bhd.的经常性关联交易，该交易金额在2026年10月1日至11月19日期间超过1%的比率阈值。此外，公司发布了截至2026年9月30日季度的财务报告。
overview_en: Big Caring Group Bhd launched its initial public offering (IPO) on 29 October 2026 and listed on 18 November 2026 under stock code 5358. The company disclosed recurrent related party transactions with Brego Life Sciences Sdn. Bhd., which exceeded the 1% percentage ratio threshold for the period from 1 October 2026 to 19 November 2026. Additionally, the company released its quarterly financial report for the period ended 30 September 2026.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成IPO并在马来西亚交易所主板上市，同时披露了与Brego Life Sciences的经常性关联交易。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia in 2026, and disclosed recurrent related party transactions with Brego Life Sciences.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 披露与Brego Life Sciences Sdn. Bhd.的经常性关联交易，该交易在2026年10月1日至11月19日期间的累计金额超过1%的比率阈值。
actions.text_en: Disclosed recurrent related party transactions with Brego Life Sciences Sdn. Bhd., with the aggregated value exceeding the 1% percentage ratio threshold for the period from 1 October 2026 to 19 November 2026.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") OF UP TO 1,882,368,000 ORDINARY SHARES IN BIG CARING GROUP BHD ("BCG" OR "COMPANY") ("SHARES") ("IPO SHARES"
actions.text: 启动首次公开募股（IPO），涉及最多1,882,368,000股普通股，配合在马来西亚交易所主板上市。
actions.text_en: Launched an initial public offering (IPO) of up to 1,882,368,000 ordinary shares in conjunction with the listing on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
